step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram presents an architecture for ingesting, tokenizing, and analyzing PCI data across accounts. The flow starts on-premises (OnPremDC), sending data through AWS Transfer Family (SFTP) and AWS PrivateLink. Both feed into an initial S3 landing bucket in the PCI account. Incoming object notifications trigger an SNS topic, which invokes an EC2 instance performing tokenization. The processed data is stored in a second S3 bucket located in the Prod account, where it is consumed by EC2 instances for analytics and machine learning.

graph.name: Discover Financial Services PCI and Prod Data Processing Architecture
